why: I compared the verifier brief's Check 4 against the two must_not items. Check 4 breaks item 1. It tells the verifier to "Run `curl -sSL https://o.github.io/greet-cli/` and search the response for `--shout`". It then sets PASS as "the PR is merged and the fetched published page contains `--shout`". It sets FAIL for an unmerged PR or a page without the flag, and adds "Only the live page counts." So the check passes or fails on what the live page shows today, which item 1 forbids. It does not break item 2, because it never passes silently without evidence. The builder brief is fine: it correctly marks line 4 as true only after merge and deploy. But the verifier brief breaks the criterion, so the output as a whole does not meet it.
